firstAidTips.title: Bleeding
info: Apply firm pressure with a clean cloth or bandage.
Keep the injured area elevated to reduce blood flow.
If bleeding doesn’t stop, seek medical help immediately.

firstAidTips.title: Burns
info: Cool the burn under running water for 10–20 minutes.
Do not apply oil, toothpaste, or butter.
Cover loosely with a clean, non-stick cloth or gauze.

firstAidTips.title: Choking
info: Encourage the person to cough if possible.
If breathing stops, perform Heimlich maneuver (abdominal thrusts).
Call emergency services if not relieved.

firstAidTips.title: Fractures
info: Do not move the injured area unnecessarily.
Immobilize with a splint or cloth support.
Apply cold packs to reduce swelling.
Seek hospital care immediately.

firstAidTips.title: Heat Stroke
info: Move the person to a cool, shaded place.
Loosen clothing and apply wet cloths.
Give small sips of water or ORS if conscious.

firstAidTips.title: Food Poisoning
info: Drink plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration.
Take small sips of ORS frequently.
Avoid spicy and oily food until recovered.
Seek medical help if severe vomiting/diarrhea persists.

firstAidTips.title: Snake Bite
info: Keep the patient calm and still.
Do not try to suck out the venom.
Keep the bitten area lower than the heart.
Seek hospital immediately for anti-venom.
medicines: No home medicine – Anti-venom at hospital only
